mu_name_from: MuMain loads the second classes' bare bodies as MODEL_BODY_GLOVE + MAX_CLASS + i from Data\\Player\\GloveClass2{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp:121-127), and GetSkinModelIndex hands CLASS_SOULMASTER, CLASS_BLADEKNIGHT and CLASS_MUSEELF skins 7, 8 and 9 (_enum.h:3250-3252, CharacterManager.cpp:240-254): Class201 the Soul Master, 202 the Blade Knight, 203 the Muse Elf.
why_this_one: Sevina's class change (the user, 2026-10-04: 'second class quest where char beccomes second class with new skins'; 'MU's way': the second class's body under any slot left empty). docs/game/class-change-quest.md.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQlevel_man022.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Soul Master's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Soul Master body, read out of Data/Player/GloveClass201.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's GloveClass201 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("okey lets make new dw and sm then", after seeing the two side by side). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
part_note: The arms and hands, 212 triangles. Bound to 29 on Bip01 R Forearm, 29 on Bip01 L Forearm, 24 on Bip01 R Hand, 24 on Bip01 L Hand, 18 on Bip01 R UpperArm, 18 on Bip01 L UpperArm, 7 on Bip01 R Finger0, 7 on Bip01 L Finger0.
